name: toggle-group
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Toggle Group for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus toggle-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select and composes the owned Toggle primitive directly), matching shadcn's Toggle Group.
documentation.accessibility: Each `ToggleItem` composes `toggle.rs`'s own `Toggle` (an APG "Button" with `aria-pressed`); the group itself adds WAI-ARIA APG Toolbar-shaped roving-tabindex semantics plus single-/multiple-pressed selection state (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toggle_group.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Single-tab-stop roving tabindex: arrow keys move focus along the group's orientation; Enter/Space (native button activation) toggles the focused item.
